title: Lubbuu Obsaan
intro: Seenaa raajii keessatti lubbuun obsi ishee huccuu jiraachuu isaanii keessatti bocame tokkotu jira ture. Imimmaanii fi yeroodhaan abdii qabatanii, ogummaa Waaqayyootti amanamuudhaaf fakkeenya yeroo hin qabne ta’aniiru. Iccitii nama hin raafamne kanaa hiikuu dandeessaa?
clues: Maatii raajota keessaa dhaladhe, ta’us qormaanni koo inni guddaan karaa mucaa baay’ee jaalladhu sanaan dhufe.
Abjuu ilmi koo qooddate irraa akeekkachiisni hinaaffaa naaf dhufe, nageenya isaas nan sodaadhe.
Ijji kiyya gaddaan adii ta'e, ta'us rahmata Rabbiitti iimaana dhabee hin beeku.
Urgaa mucaa koo isa bade fagoodhaa na bira ga’ee, yeroo sanatti deebi’ee wal arguun akka dhihaate nan beeka ture.
Maatiin koo yeroo mul’anni durii raawwatamu, ija koos deebi’ee yeroo argatu galata guddaadhaan jilbeenfatan.
Ani nama shamizii dhiigaan faalamee dhiyaate, boodarra shamizii ija koo fayyise qofa argadhe.

trial.label: Dhaddacha Murteessaa
options: Mucaa jaallatamaa irraa adda bahuu fi ija dhabuu
Qabeenya, ijoollee, fi fayyaa dhabuu dandamachuu
Obboleeyyan isaatiin gantee boolla bishaanii keessatti gatamuu
trial.answer: Mucaa jaallatamaa irraa adda bahuu fi ija dhabuu

location.label: Wanti Mallattoo
options: Qamisa jalqaba dhugaa dhoksite sana booda mul'ise
Sandaala tokko bosona gubaa jiru irratti
location.answer: Qamisa jalqaba dhugaa dhoksite sana booda mul'ise

outcome.label: Murtoo Waaqaa
options: Nama jaallannu bade waliin deebi'anii wal arguu fi ija namaa deebisuu
outcome.answer: Nama jaallannu bade waliin deebi'anii wal arguu fi ija namaa deebisuu

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
